_about: Corrections to the MCCME catalogue used by the site (the same as in the companion's package builder). date_fixes: records whose catalogued date is a misprint, with the date used and the reason. empty_records: records of the MCCME list that have no pages in the archive (talks without notes); from manifest.json > source_limitations > empty_catalogue_records of this repository (main, 11 Nov 2026, commit a19e1802). Their academic year is derived from date_as_catalogued.

510.reason: The records lie between 16-Feb-81 and 23-Feb-81 in the numbering and the pages (P000958-P000963), and 23 Feb 1981 was a Monday (the seminar day) while 23 Feb 1991 was a Saturday: a misprint.
